title: Settings
noLibrary: No library selected. Please select a library first.

device.title: Device
device.name: Device Name
device.slugHint: Unique identifier for this device (alphanumeric and hyphens only)
device.slugInvalid: Use only letters, numbers and hyphens, up to 50 characters.

background.title: Background
background.keepRunningHint: Closing the window keeps WingDrive in the tray so folders open instantly
background.startAtLoginHint: Start WingDrive hidden in the tray when you log in
background.terminalHint: Command for Open Terminal Here. Leave empty to use xdg-terminal-exec, $TERMINAL or an installed terminal.

fileChooser.title: File chooser
fileChooser.enable: Use WingDrive to pick files in other apps
fileChooser.hint: Uploads and saves in browsers, Flatpak and GTK4 apps open WingDrive. Edits {{file}} and restores the previous chooser when turned off.
fileChooser.notInstalled: Needs wingdrive.portal from the WingDrive package. Builds from source must install it by hand.
fileChooser.failed: Could not change the file chooser: {{error}}

reset.title: Reset All Data
reset.hint: Permanently delete all libraries and settings
reset.confirm:
Reset All Data

This will permanently delete all libraries, settings, and cached data. The app will need to be restarted. Are you sure?
reset.done: Data has been reset. Please restart the application.

library.description: Configure settings for the current library.
library.systemVolumesHint: Track internal drives when the library opens
library.externalVolumesHint: Automatically track external drives when connected

indexer.description: Configure what files are indexed in your library.
indexer.skipSystemHint: Ignore OS system files and directories
indexer.skipHiddenHint: Ignore files starting with a dot
indexer.appliesNextScan: These rules apply to locations you add from now on. Locations you already added keep their current index.

services.restartWarning: Changes to service settings may require a daemon restart to take effect.
services.networkingHint: Enable P2P networking and device pairing
services.volumeMonitoringHint: Monitor for connected and disconnected volumes
services.fsWatcherHint: Watch for file changes in tracked locations
services.statisticsHint: Listen for and update library statistics
services.pairingDescription: After you pair two devices directly, a paired device can introduce a new one to the rest of your devices.
services.acceptVouchedHint: Trust devices that one of your paired devices vouches for, without pairing them again
services.vouchToAllHint: When you pair a new device, vouch for it to all your other paired devices
services.wingdropDescription: Paired devices can offer you files. Accepted files land in the folder below.
services.wingdropEnabledHint: Let paired devices offer files to this device
services.wingdropAutoAcceptHint: Save files from paired devices right away
services.wingdropFolderHint: Where received files are saved. Leave empty for Downloads.

privacy.telemetryBody: WingDrive does not collect usage data. Your files, file names and library contents stay on your devices unless you share them.

advanced.description: Advanced configuration options for power users.
advanced.warning: These settings are for expert users. Incorrect configuration may affect performance.
advanced.debugLogsHint: Include verbose debug information in job logs
advanced.debugLogsBody: Every background job writes a log. Debug entries make those logs much larger and take effect after the daemon restarts. Set the daemon log level with the RUST_LOG environment variable.

about.tagline: A file explorer from the future.
about.manifesto: Infrastructure for the next era of computing. An architecture designed for multi-device environments from the ground up—not cloud services retrofitted with offline support, but local-first sync that scales to the cloud when you want it.

restartNeeded: Some changes take effect after the daemon restarts.

integrations.description: Connect accounts from other services. Google Drive becomes a volume you browse, copy to and sync with; Google Photos receives uploads and lets you import picked photos.

google.title: Google accounts
google.description: Connect as many Google accounts as you want. Each one keeps its own Drive and Photos access.
google.notConfigured: Sign-in needs a Google OAuth client. Add one in "Google sign-in client" below.
google.waiting: Finish signing in in your browser…
google.driveHint: Adds the Drive to the sidebar and to copy and sync destinations
google.confirmDisconnect: Disconnect this account and revoke WingDrive's access?

photos.importHint: Google opens a page where you pick photos and videos. WingDrive downloads them at full quality into the folder you choose.

sync.title: Cloud sync
sync.description: Keep a folder on this device in step with a folder in Google Drive.
sync.needsDrive: Connect a Google account with Drive shown in WingDrive to sync folders.
sync.name: Name
sync.remoteFolderHint: Path inside My Drive, such as Backup/Laptop. It is created if missing.
sync.manual: Only when I click Run now
sync.propagateDeletesHint: Deleting a synced file on one side moves it to the trash on the other
sync.created: Folder sync created; the first run has started
sync.summary: Last run {{when}}: {{uploaded}} up, {{downloaded}} down, {{conflicts}} conflicts, {{errors}} errors

edit.title: Cloud files being edited
edit.description: Files opened from the cloud upload back each time you save them.
edit.synced: Up to date in the cloud
edit.conflict: Changed in the cloud meanwhile; your version was saved as {{name}}
edit.closeFailed: Could not upload the last changes: {{error}}

client.title: Google sign-in client
client.description: WingDrive signs in to Google with an OAuth client. Use the one in this build, or your own.
client.step1: In Google Cloud Console, create a project and enable the Google Drive API, Photos Library API and Photos Picker API.
client.step2: Configure the OAuth consent screen and add your Google accounts as test users.
client.step3: Create credentials of type OAuth client ID, application type Desktop app.
client.step4: Paste the client ID and client secret here.
